description:
Hi dear dancers!!!

TikTek invite you for a special session, this time at the beautiful Forest of Essência close to Aljezur, Sunday the 17th of May.

We will start at 6 pm and the proposal is to Dance and Dance and Dance!!! We will play an Ecstatic Dance with Live Music and a lot of 🎵 Rhythm!!!

 Let’s get together and enjoy!!!

Contribution: 20 Euros

Just come!!!!
short_description: A special Ecstatic Dance session with live music in the beautiful forest of Essência. An evening of dance, live music, rhythm, and connection—immersing together in movement, freedom, and celebration in nature.
title: TikTek Ecstatic Dance
